info.title: MtaaFix API
info.description: Centralized REST API for the MtaaFix community issue-reporting and response platform. PostgreSQL + PostGIS backend.

tags.name: Dashboard
tags.description: Dashboard endpoints for user statistics and overview

tags.name: Analytics
tags.description: Analytics and reports (P23; PostgreSQL-only spatial filtering — H2 covers parameter validation only)

tags.name: Settings
tags.description: System settings (P24; read-only in MVP per FR-12.3)

tags.name: Reports
tags.description: Report lifecycle: create, review, work, resolution, closure

put.summary: Activate or deactivate a user account (FR-12.1, audited)

get.summary: Get a report (ownership / organisation scope enforced)

put.summary: Update a report (creator only; SUBMITTED or NEEDS_INFORMATION)

get.summary: Get an organisation (ADMIN all; ORG_ADMIN own only)
Get my notification preferences (FR-6.4)

put.summary: Update a category (FR-5.1, admin only, audited)
Set a category's display order (FR-5.1, audited)
Activate or deactivate a category (FR-5.1, audited)
Update own profile (full name / mobile only)

get.summary: List reports (role-scoped; status/categoryId/orgId/q/assignment filters, pagination)

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text search over code, title and description (P15)

post.summary: Create a report (category required; unique code generated; optional Idempotency-Key header makes offline retries exactly-once, Phase 14)

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional idempotency key (16-64 chars [A-Za-z0-9_-]); a replay returns the stored response without creating a second report

post.summary: Verify a report (T5)
Claim a report for review (T2/T17)
Start work on an assigned report (T10)
Return a completion claim to active work (T12; comment mandatory)
Creator resubmits after providing information (T4)
Approve a completion claim (T13)
Reopen a closed report (T16; justification mandatory)
Reject a report (T6; reasonCode + comment mandatory)
Request more information from the creator (T3)
Attach photo evidence (FR-9.1; MIME allowlist + 20 MiB limit, FR-9.2)
Upload a photo file (multipart; Phase 7 citizen wizard, FR-9.1/9.2)
Mark a report as duplicate (T7; canonical report link mandatory)
Dispute a resolution (T15; disputeReason mandatory)
Citizen confirms resolution and closes (T14; optional feedback)
Claim completion with evidence (T11; at least one photo required)
Comment on a report (FR-2.8)
Close a report as administrator (T14)
Cancel own report before review (T8; creator + SUBMITTED only)
Assign a report (T9/T9r; administrator or owning organisation)

get.summary: List organisations (ADMIN all; ORG_ADMIN own only)

post.summary: Create an organisation (FR-5.3, audited)

get.summary: List organisation members (P21)

post.summary: Add a member (grants org role, audited)
Mark a notification as read
Mark all notifications as read

get.summary: Get active categories (picker list; admins may include inactive)

post.summary: Create a new category (FR-5.1, admin only, audited)
Register a new user
Refresh an access token
Complete a password reset with a single-use token (FR-1.7)
Request a password reset link (always 202, non-disclosing - FR-1.7)
Change own password while authenticated
Log out
Log in

get.summary: Search users (FR-12.1: text + role + active filters)

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text search over email and full name

get.summary: Public aggregate statistics (counts only; no identity or PII)
Effective system settings (ADMINISTRATOR only; secrets masked)
Public explore feed (search/category/status/date/bbox/near filters, pagination; public fields only, generalized locations per FR-11.4)

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Bounding box 'minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat' (PostgreSQL spatial query; cannot be combined with near)

parameters.name: near
parameters.description: Radius search 'lat,lon,radiusKm' (PostgreSQL spatial query; cannot be combined with bbox)

get.summary: Public report detail by reference code (public fields only)
Get my notifications
Get my unread notification count (badges)
Download media bytes (owner + authorized roles only, FR-9.3)
Get global statistics
Get organization statistics
Get current user's dashboard summary
Admin dashboard panels (P14: cards, activity, distribution, moderation queue, workload, attention, recent reports)
Get active categories (public, unauthenticated filter list for FR-8.3)
Get global audit log (admin only, filtered)
Get organisation audit log (ORG_ADMIN own scope, filtered)
Get organisation's reports
Get my assignments
Analytics summary with date/category/status/organisation/geo filters

parameters.name: orgId
parameters.description: Organisation id filter (ORG_ADMIN is forced to own org)

delete.summary: Remove a member (affiliation only; role unchanged, audited)
Remove own media from a report (FR-9.2)

UpdateRoleRequest.description: Request to change a user's role (FR-5.4, FR-12.1; ADMINISTRATOR only, audited). Organisation roles (ORGANIZATION_ADMIN, FIELD_WORKER) must be granted through an organisation membership instead.

SetActiveRequest.description: Request to activate or deactivate a user account (FR-12.1; ADMINISTRATOR only, audited). Deactivated users are rejected on every request.

geoJson.description: GeoJSON Point (exact, FR-11.5; authorized surfaces only)

UpdateOrganisationRequest.description: Request to update an organisation (FR-5.3; null fields keep current values; slug is immutable after creation)

OrganisationActiveRequest.description: Request to activate or deactivate an organisation account (P21; ADMINISTRATOR only, audited). Deactivated orgs cannot receive new assignments.

NotificationPreferenceRequest.description: Partial update of notification preferences; omitted fields are unchanged

pushEnabled.description: Enable/disable push notifications (no provider configured yet)

NotificationPreferenceDto.description: Notification preferences for the current user (FR-6.4)

pushEnabled.description: Push channel opted in (stored for future use)

pushAvailable.description: Whether a push provider is configured on this deployment

CategoryDto.description: Report category representation (FR-5.1; active/displayOrder are admin-managed and optional on write)

active.description: Whether the category can be chosen for new reports

CategoryOrderRequest.description: Request to set a category's display order (FR-5.1)

UpdateProfileRequest.description: Request to update the signed-in user's profile (full name and mobile only; email and password are not editable here)

CreateReportRequest.description: Request to create a new report

ReturnReportRequest.description: Reviewer returns a completion claim to active work (T12)

comment.description: Mandatory comment explaining what still needs work

ReopenReportRequest.description: Administrator reopen of a closed report (T16)

RejectReportRequest.description: Request to reject a report (reason code + comment mandatory, T6/T8)

reasonCode.description: Reason code, e.g. REJECTED_AS_POLICY or CANCELLED_BY_CITIZEN

NeedsInfoRequest.description: Request more information from the report creator (T3)

message.description: Message describing what information is required

CreateMediaRequest.description: Request to add media evidence to a report

DuplicateReportRequest.description: Mark a report as duplicate of a canonical report (T7)

DisputeReportRequest.description: Citizen dispute of a resolved report (T15)

disputeReason.description: Mandatory reason for disputing the resolution

ConfirmReportRequest.description: Citizen/administrator confirmation closing a resolved report (T14)

feedback.description: Optional citizen feedback about the resolution

CompleteReportRequest.description: Field-worker completion claim (T11); at least one PHOTO must already be attached

CreateCommentRequest.description: Request to add a comment to a report

AssignReportRequest.description: Request to assign a report to a user

organisationId.description: Organisation id, when assigning on behalf of an organisation

AddMemberRequest.description: Request to add a member to an organisation (P21, B-X.3). Grants the org role (FR-5.4, audited) and creates the membership in one step.

RegisterRequest.description: Request to register a new user. Registration always creates a CITIZEN account; staff roles are granted later by an administrator (FR-1.1, FR-5.4).

RefreshRequest.description: Request to exchange a refresh token for a new token pair

ResetPasswordRequest.description: Complete a password reset with a single-use expiring token (FR-1.7)

token.description: Raw reset token from the email link

ForgotPasswordRequest.description: Request a password reset link. The response is identical whether or not the email exists (FR-1.7 non-disclosure).

PublicStatsDto.description: Public platform statistics (aggregate counts only; FR-8.1)

SettingsDto.description: Effective system settings (read-only in MVP, FR-12.3)

PublicReportSummaryDto.description: Public report summary (FR-8.3 explore feed; public fields only)

PublicReportDetailDto.description: Public report detail (FR-8.4; public fields only, generalized location)

duplicateOfCode.description: Canonical reference when this report is a duplicate

PublicTimelineEntryDto.description: High-level public timeline entry (status + timestamp only)

UserDashboardDto.description: User dashboard summary with attention-required data (FR-7.1, FR-7.4)

AdminDashboardDto.description: Admin dashboard (P14): summary cards, activity, distribution, moderation queue, workload, attention and recent reports — all derived from real data (FR-7.4)

newLast7Days.description: Reports created in the last 7 days

activity14d.description: Daily report counts for the last 14 days (Africa/Dar_es_Salaam)

recent.description: Most recent reports (with exact coordinates; staff only)

actorEmail.description: Actor email (resolved; null when the actor no longer exists)

AnalyticsSummaryDto.description: Analytics summary (P23): every metric is computed from real report data with the applied filters echoed back (FR-7.4)

avgResolutionHours.description: Average hours from submission to first RESOLVED/CLOSED (closed reports only)

organisations.description: Top organisations by matching assigned reports
